knowledge_graph.title: Bankers Life
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Dating back to 1879, Bankers Life provides a broad selection of life and health insurance products designed for Americans who are near or in retirement. With 230 offices, our 4,500 insurance agents/producers live and work in their local communities. Our agents take the time to get to know you, listen to your needs and values, and are dedicated to helping you meet your goals for a secure retirement. Get to know Bankers Life - and learn why our 1.1 million customers trust us to help protect their financial future, ensuring a healthier and rewarding retirement. Bankers Life is part of CNO Financial Group, Inc., whose companies provide life and health insurance, annuities, financial services and workforce benefits solutions."

related_questions.question: What happened to Bankers Life Insurance company?

text_blocks.snippet: Bankers Life Insurance Company, not to be confused with Bankers Life and Casualty Company, is in court-ordered liquidation effective November 30, 2024. This means its policy obligations are now covered by various state life and health insurance guaranty associations, subject to applicable limits.

list.title: Liquidation:
list.snippet: Bankers Life Insurance Company was placed into liquidation by a North Carolina court, with the order becoming effective on November 30, 2024.

list.title: Guaranty Associations:
list.snippet: When a life insurance company is liquidated, state guaranty associations step in to protect policyholders. These associations provide coverage for policy obligations, subject to certain limits.

list.title: Coverage Limits:
list.snippet: The specific amount of coverage provided by each state's guaranty association varies, but it is capped by state law.

list.title: Further Information:
list.snippet: Policyholders can find more information on the specific state guaranty association's website or the website of the National Organization of Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Associations (NOLHGA).

list.title: Not the Same as Bankers Life and Casualty:
list.snippet: It's important to note that Bankers Life Insurance Company is a separate entity from Bankers Life and Casualty Company, a subsidiary of CNO Financial Group, according to Bankers Life. The latter continues to operate and serve its customers.

text_blocks.snippet: Bankers Life is an insurance company that focuses on providing financial security for individuals, particularly those near or in retirement. They offer a range of insurance products, including life insurance, Medicare Supplement insurance, and long-term care insurance. Bankers Life is part of the CNO Financial Group family of brands.
Here's a more detailed look at Bankers Life:

list.title: Life Insurance:
list.snippet: Bankers Life offers both term and whole life insurance policies. Whole life policies build cash value that can be accessed through loans or withdrawals. They also offer riders like accidental death and disability benefits.

list.title: Medicare Supplement Insurance:
list.snippet: They are a major provider of Medicare Supplement insurance, helping people navigate healthcare costs in retirement.

list.title: Long-Term Care Insurance:
list.snippet: Bankers Life offers long-term care insurance to help with costs associated with extended care needs.

list.title: Annuities:
list.snippet: They also offer annuities, which can provide a stream of income during retirement.

list.title: Personalized Approach:
list.snippet: Bankers Life emphasizes a personalized approach, with agents meeting with clients to understand their individual needs and financial goals.

list.title: Focus on Retirement:
list.snippet: Their products and services are specifically tailored to help individuals prepare for and manage retirement.

list.title: Trusted Brand:
list.snippet: Bankers Life has a long history, dating back to 1879, and is accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an A+ rating.

list.title: Financial Strength:
list.snippet: Bankers Life is rated A (Excellent) by AM Best for financial strength.

list.title: Customer Service:
list.snippet: They aim to provide excellent service, including online account management and claims assistance.
